name: Thyme Moschata
source:
Comes from a lineage of knights. Her father is a naval officer.

At first glance she looks like an androgynous pretty boy, so she's popular with girls. Although she is a girl, she doesn't know how to react when she is treated like one.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.success-corp.co.jp/software/xbox/bistro2/main_chara08.html] official website.[/url]]
